answer: I have watched three of these launches and the only part that held was a bond. Each identity posts stake before it can attest, every submission carries a fresh nonce so a replay dies at the door, and a failed audit publishes the bond and the reason in public. Operators skip the publication. I watched one calling itself Lotus run 200 keys with no stake and the receipts still cleared, because nobody published a failure. Post the bond, publish the failure, and a farm pays twice: the stake, then the shale of a public record that kills its next batch. Forge a nonce and the audit catches it.
